entities.summary:
Xavier Leroy is a French computer scientist and programmer. He is best known for his role as a primary developer of the OCaml system. He is 
Professor of software science at Collège de France. Before his appointment at Collège de France in 2018, he was senior scientist at the French government research institution Inria.
